balls.text: Balaji, zara dheere chalo! The smiling assassin has bowled a memorable final over and finished off with a lovely little yorker. If you can keep it that full, you don't need pace. That landed at Rana's toes even as he searched in vain for any little room. There was none, he misses the heave, and leg stump fell back.
length ball on the pads, Parnell flicks to deep midwicket. Only a single. Can they get 120?
slow offcutter, this time it lands and breaks in. Another pull, it goes squarer this time, for one more.
filth from Bala, sends down a high full toss, called a no-ball and earns him a warning. Rana pulls it behind square leg for a couple.

Last-over Lakshmipathy has a wicket! Sends down a surprise short ball angling across Yuvraj, who is late on the dragged pull. Top edge, spirals up, and Goswami settles under it. They check if it was a no-ball, but that's clean. Bala had some part of the foot behind the line.
another ball full and straight on off, nothing Rana can do with it and forces it away to mid off for one.
full length from over the wicket, wide of the crease, and Yuvraj angles it towards the covers for one.

he's doing all he can to get under Lee, and he's not being allowed to. Another signature full ball outside off, Yuvraj tries to go up and over, but gets only as far as long off. He keeps strike though.

this time Yuvraj moves inside the line as Lee spears it in, and ends up whipping it to deep midwicket off the back foot. Two more. No wait, they only get a single since Rana hasn't completed the first one cleanly.

cat and mouse stuff this! Concerned by the umpire's not so stringent standards, Yuvraj reaches well out to another potential wide and squeezes it away towards extra cover. Rana hares back to give him the strike.
this one angles into him, and Yuvraj muscles it away to the square leg area without timing for a couple.
Yuvraj looks completely confused, and so are we. Another one full and wide outside off, this was surely well outside the tram line. Yuvraj gestures in anger, and rightly so.
lovely little slow offcutter, Rana was initially fooled before nudging it away fine, and Goswami does really well to stop it as he dives away to his left.
full and on off stump to end the over, this Rana can pack some power into these shots. This time, he finds sweeper cover though with an inside out carve.
another heave missed by Yuvraj. Full and straight from Kallis, Yuvraj inside-edges the swing to the leg side for one.
aha, that was in Yuvraj's hitting length, but not in the hitting line. Full and well wide of off stump, Yuvraj sets up a slid base and swings hard, but he gets it right back to Kallis.
back of a length outside off, this time he just drops it towards point for a quick single.

even better from Rana. He gets another short ball, this one angling in, but there are two men prowling in the deep. Rana knows it, and ensures he places it between them, in front of square, and picks up four.
and that's why seamers haven't bowled much today. Kallis lands this short and wide outside off, Rana gives it everything and carves it powerfully over point. Well played.
hmm, again Lee lands it full and wide. Yuvraj leaves and looks beseechingly at the umpire. Not called.
short ball, Rana hops back and guides the pull to deep square leg for a single.
straighter this time, Yuvraj works it towards midwicket for another single.

Superb shot. Yuvraj knows Lee is going to do this again, full and outside off. He just waits, fractionally opens up the off side, opens up the face and guides him with the pace of the ball to third man. That flew.
and here's another one. Yuvraj again goes for a steer and misses.
full and wide of off stump, Yuvraj looks to steer but is late on the shot and it runs under the blade.
Yuvraj goes for a sweep, gets pad on it for a leg-bye to short fine leg. Time for another stretch-my-legs time-out.
short ball on middle, Yuvraj punches wide of mid-on for an easy couple.
back of a length outside off, he cuts it but can't beat backward point. Single taken, all the same.
poor ball, wasted by Rana. Full on leg stump, and whipped straight to backward square leg.
speared on the leg stump, Yuvraj can't time the fine sweep too well and Gambhir at short fine cleans up.
Rana does the wise thing, works a length ball turning in, through square leg for one.
finishes the over with a smart, fullish ball outside out that Yuvraj strikes right back to the bowler.
Yuvraj misses the hoick over the leg side. The ball hit the edge and ran towards short third man. That's how much he missed it by.
aha, drives uppishly and nearly finds Tiwary at cover. Solidly struck, but on the up and into the deep extra cover region for a single.
short of a length this time, he stays in the crease and defends.
another cutter from Bhatia, gets it to stop on the batsman. Rana dabs with soft hands to point.
back of a length on middle and leg, Yuvraj plays it down to mid-on

another wicket, another one falls to spin. Uthappa gets a short ball turning down the leg side and unleashes the strong slog whack through the leg side, but he decides to go flat. Would have still cleared the rope if Lee wasn't prowling in the deep. He was, though.
Yuvraj stays back and works a length ball down the track for another single.
he goes big over the leg side this time, but they aren't timing too many today, are Pune. Balloons up towards midwicket, and they get a single.
another ill-advised reverse sweep, another miss. Uthappa is lucky he wasn't given lbw, that was close.
Yusuf tals into the covers for a single.

Abdulla can create spin, but not handle it too well! Yuvraj leans across and blasts the sweep shot out towards deep square leg, to the right of Abdulla in the deep. He runs across and thinks he has it covered, when it pitches and wrong foots him with the spin.

Every now and then, Uthappa will pre-meditate a reverse sweep, it doesn't matter where the bowler lands it. This one was speared in, full on middle, and he still went for it. The ball popped away through the vacant slip area.
another armer, Yuvraj plays for the spin and gets a leading edge through cover point.
attempts the reverse sweep and misses as Shakib sends down another deceptive armer.
tossed up, worked with the spin to the leg side

Shakib deserved Ganguly's scalp and there is some justice in the world. The Bangla tiger has nailed the Bengal tiger. Tame, tame dismissal. Loopy ball on off and breaking in, Ganguly looks to reach across and lap it around to the leg side, but slaps it straight to Yusuf at backward square leg. He did well to time his jump and haul it in.
Uthappa works him with the spin through short third man for one.

again Ganguly escapes a potential stumping, and ends up at the other end. Shakib sees him running down the track and lands this short and wide of leg stump. It turns way down the leg side, Goswami tumbles away and collects, and shies as he falls. And misses. Ganguly then trots across.
back of a length outside off stump, Uthappa cuts hard but finds backward point.
Ganguly reaches out to the fullish delivery and tries to steer through point. Finds the gap and gets a single.
straight ball, sanity resumes, Uthappa drives to long on for a single.
horror ball, lands a mile outside leg and no one had a chance to stop that. Runs away for five wides.
better from Uthappa, stays behind the line and defends down the track.

Uthappa attempts suicide and jumps over the cliff, but somehow lands on a very comfortable haystack. Short of a length on middle and off, he goes for an awry pull shot and cross-bats it into orbit. Balaji at midwicket never looked like he was going to catch it, and ended up missing it by a metre or so.
length ball, stops on Uthappa who defends down the track a tad uppishly
straighter this time and again holds its line, Uthappa sweeps for a single.
lovely little armer from Shakib, but unlike Manish Pandey, Uthappa is well forward and pushing outside the line when it hits the pads. Big appeal in vain.
Uthappa goes for a sweep from as wide outside off as you'd believe is feasible. And still misses. It turns even more than he accounts for.
back of a length outside off, Uthappa stays in the crease and defends.
here comes the reverse sweep from Uthappa, he plays this shot almost compulsively these days. Short of a length, breaking away, he reverse slaps it fine enough to beat short third man.
turns away from outside off, Uthappa angles it away backward of point.

he's still got it. Ganguly has smashed a majestic straight six. This used to be his hobby against left-arm spin. It don't matter where it is landed, it don't matter how much it is turning in. The more the better. Dada's quick feet get across to the pitch, and his quicker hands do the rest. Big six straight down the ground.
armer skids across Ganguly, who taps it behind point for one.
Uthappa drives with the turn, solid through mid-off for a single.
he prances out this time, gets to the pitch of a flighted ball and looks to loft over the leg side. But he isn't the batsman he once was. Bounces well inside, single taken.
and here's one that turns in so much from well wide of the crease, that it finishes closer to the stumps and is not called a wide.
hmm, tight stuff on off stump, Ganguly dabs towards point and tires to pinch a single, but the keeper is alert.
Ganguly pushes another single down the ground. KKR calling the shots at the first pointless time-out of the day.
this one straightens into him, and Uthappa works it away to the leg side for one.
another one that turns big from outside off. Robin wisely leaves.

the ball of the century did not turn as much as this one did. This is some pitch! Three wickets to spin, and Pune continue to wobble. Shakib delivers it round-arm from wide of the crease, gets it to lands short of a length outside off as Ferguson advances. He's already fooled by the length, and he's about to be flabbergasted by the turn. The ball went away  as if it doesn't agree with physics. Goswami does the rest. Ferguson won't ever comprehend what the ball did there.
Ganguly is dealing in single, he pushes a length ball wide of mid-on for one more.
if there is a sweepstakes competition in Navi Mumbai, Ferguson will win. Tossed up on middle, another full-blooded sweep, but there is protection in the deep square leg area.
another single into the straight field to end the over. Pune need some release here.
length ball on the stumps, Ganguly gets forward and drives solidly wide of mid on
another sweep, this time Ferguson gets it square and picks up a single.

aha, the first blemish from KKR. To be fair to Lee it was never going to be easy to field a spinning sweep shot going away from him at short fine leg. He ran in and put in the dive, but only managed to parry it along to the boundary.
full ball on the stumps and a solid little sweep to the deep for a couple.
back of a length on middle and leg, Ganguly nudges to the leg side for one.
Ferguson keeps out a fullish ball. Phew! Eventful over.
Ganguly goes for the big loft over long-on, and doesn't time it. On the bounce to the man in the deep., Hmmm.
short and breaking away, Ferguson forces it to the leg side for one.
top-quality armer from round the wicket. Beats Ferg all ends up, and somehow misses the stumps.

a typical Dada kind of moment. He pounces out to Shakib, who smartly shortens the length, Ganguly is in no-man's land and goes for a half-hearted pull and the ball pops up behind him. Did he edge it? he might have. Did Goswami know he edged it? Probably not. Instead of taking the rebound, he waited for it to see if it landed on the stumps. It did not. And the ball then ran away behind, with the keeper in front of the stumps. Ganguly then ran for the single!
length ball on off, Ganguly defends gingerly.
this one is on the pads and turning down, Ganguly gets pad on it for a single to short fine leg.
big turn! Short ball, lands outside off and boomerangs in to Ganguly who fends it away in a hurry.

how close was that? Huge lbw appeal, not given. Another sweep attempted by Ganguly, this time he misses and it thuds into the pad in front of middle. Seemed to have landed close to leg or just outside.
short of a length on the stumps, Ferguson works it away to midwicket for one more.
Ganguly looks to paddle a straight ball, and got a bit of bat on it for a single behind square. Half an appeal, but it was bat first.
this one slides across Ganguly and holds its line, he reaches half out and defends.
wide down the leg side this time. Ganguly stays inside the line.
shot of the innings so far. Ferguson doesn't back away this time, and waits for a length ball to angle into the zone before swiping it with the angle over deep square leg. First six of the innings.
aha, nearly a drop. Ferguson again looks to stay put on leg stump and crack a short ball away. He yorks the fielder at point, who does well to get something behind it.
a touch of trademark Ganguly, mark 2003-4. He backs away to a short ball, trying to make room for the booming hit, but since there is no width in the end he just dabs through backward point.
Ferg's played a lot of shots without connecting with too many. Short ball at 130 kph, he gets across and looks to pull hard. Gets only a single as he mistimes through square leg.
swish and a miss. Ferguson backs away to a short ball and looks to carve over the off side. Doesn't make contact.
back of a length on middle and leg. Ganguly plays defensively to the leg side for another single.
top over. Finishes with a length ball speared onto the stumps, and Ferguson plays it back down the track.
back of a length on middle and breaking away, Ferguson gets away and works against the spin to the leg side.
turner first up, Ganguly quietly works it with the spin towards square leg.

what joy to watch the classic left-arm deception work in the hit and giggle format! Abdulla has laid a trap with the first two balls, and Pandey walks into it. The first ball turned away a mile, the second one was tossed up and got Pandey reaching across to smother it. This time, Abdulla shortens the length and slips in the armer. Pandey had no clue, got half across and groped outside the line. The ball shot through and hit him in front of middle and leg. Plumb.
tossed up, Pandey gets to the flight and plays it with the spin towards mid-off.
as he's done many times this season, Abdulla produces a ripper than curls in, lands, and turns away like a fiend. How does he do it? Pandey feels for it and misses.
finishes off with another one of those very full balls on middle and off, Ferguson dead bats.
short to Ferguson, and he whacks the cut straight to point.

close! Direct hit might have made this very close. Interesting ball from Lee, a full swinging slower ball at 108 kph, Pandey spots it and bunts straight to mid-on and takes off for a single. Gambhir missed, he may have just made his ground though.
not so much finesse in this one, he just plonks the front foot forward and heaves on the up. He gets the short of length ball wide of mid-on, Gambhir tags it and keeps it down to two.

ah, how early was he on the pull? It was short from Lee, but not as pacy as usual. Pandey was in position early, swivelled onto the back foot, rolled the wrists and played the pull emphatically through midwicket.
Lee lands it on a length, Pandey stays in the crease and plays it down the track.

short of a length outside off, poor calling. If there was any calling, that is. Steered towards point, Ferg runs, Pandey doesn't. Ferg stops, Pandey starts running. The charade stops just before it ends in shambles.
tossed up for a change, Pandey has a big heave at it but can't connect with the shot too well. Single taken.
Yusuf's keeping it tight, again fullish length on the stumps and Pandey works it to the leg side.
flat and quick on middle and off, played back to the bowler.

well, it took Ryder exactly one ball to go after Yusuf. And he's failed. Looks to shimmy a foot towards leg stump to create room, and tries to hoist him straight. He ends up scooping it straight up and it's a tame catch inside the circle for mid-off
begins with a tight length ball, and Ryder defends. How long before he goes after him?

short of a length outside off, and Pandey is in a spot if bother. The ball takes off again, some bounce on this track, Pandey can't ride it and fends unconvincingly. It flies away just wide of slip who leaps at full-tilt to his right, and can't get hand to it.
Pandey's away with a crisp little cover drive from the crease. He stays put, no feet movement and other such trifles, just charms it away through the line into the covers.
Ryder's away, stays beside the line to a full delivery just outside off and steers backward of point for a single.
on a length this time, Ryder stays stuck on the back foot and pokes it out to the off side

aha, top-gun bouncer and lively work behind the stumps from Goswami. It took off from back of a length, Ryder weaved away, and it kept rising. The keeper jumped up full length and pouched it in one glove.
fullish ball on middle to start off, seemed to move away a touch. Ryder defended into the off side from the crease.

the game ends in comic fashion. Bhatia gets a wide ball outside off, and under-edges to short third man where Pandey fields, loses balance as he tries to throw, and throws towards short cover. Easy single, KKR move up to 16 points.
full and wide outside off, Gambhir levels the scores by cutting hard toward point where Ryder stops it to keep the game going.
back of a length outside off, Gambhir stays on the crease and guides to point.
length ball on the pads, Gambhir can't get it away as he looks to nurdle. Rajat Bhatia at the non-striker's end must think he's looking at a mirror. Rana's action is rather reminiscent of his.

this time he misses one as it angles past him. Two to win. Perfect timing for a strategic time-out. Bhatia and Gambhir can discuss just how to pace this chase, while Pune can check if they have a Malinga in their midst to pull this one back.
fullish length, Bhatia leans out and drives into the covers.

and once again, Ganguly says it ain't over until it is over. It can't end without another one of my little moments of confounding brilliance. Yusuf is gone, Dada has taken a screamer at mid-off to send him back. Full length ball on middle, Yusuf doesn't get forward and looks to loft and it balloons away wide of mid-off. Ganguly moves away as swiftly as a 40-year old can, to his left, puts out both hands as he tumbles and takes it as he lands and rolls. Try and keep this man out of the game.
another short ball, Yusuf is in no position to handle this spicy stuff. Ouch.
good short ball, takes off, makes Yusuf fend awkwardly at it as he tries to tackles it from the crease
works a length ball down the ground for a single.
aha, high full toss was close to being no-balled but he got away with it.
lovely hit to finish the over, Gambhir dances down the track, reaches the pitch of the ball and lofts over extra cover. Not Rahul Sharma's best day in office, this.
googly goes away from Gambhir, who stays in the crease and taps towards point.
short ball turns into Yusuf, he laps it in the air over towards midwicket, but it lands in no-man's land.
marginally wide of off stump, Yusuf looks for that cut again, this time he can't get it away.
marginally short, Yusuf looks for the big heave over the leg side, and gets it away for a couple.
tossed up outside off by Rahul, Gambhir steers into the covers for a single.
yorker on the stumps, Yusuf punches to Yuvraj at mid-off to end the over.
another slow legcutter on off stump, this time Yusuf gives it the respect it deserves and defends into the off side.
length ball on off stump, Gambhir pushes another single into the covers. KKR walking home.
slower ball on off stump, Yusuf is notorious for his slow running between the wickets. Parnell runs in, collects and has a go, but misses.
fuller length, Yusuf looks to whack it straight though he is on the back foot. Mistimed, down the track.

gulp. Yusuf has wecomed Bhuvnesh back to the crease with a visceral pull over deep midwicket. Like Babe Ruth, says Brad Hogg on air. Short ball, friendly pace, and insufficiently long boundary. Easy six.
tighter line, on middle and leg, Gambhir defends from the crease.

utter shambles from Bhuvnesh on the point fence. Width for Gambhir outside off and he cuts it sweetly backward of point. Bhuvnesh was sweeping, and should have stopped it., but fumbled with a lazy effort.
now Gambhir advances, reaches the pitch and launches it over wide mid-on for two more.
back to conventional left-arm spin, it comes into Gambhir who cuts without timing to point.
this one slides on with the arm, Gambhir again tries to cut, but misses.
another one that turns in big from a left armer. Gambhir has no room as it breaks back in, and aborts the cut.
short of a length, this time on the pads, and Gambhir dabs another single to midwicket.
width this time as Gambhir jumps out, and he creams it through point for two more.
short ball, meets with some patent Yusuf brutality. Clubbed to deep midwicket, where Rana does well to stop it and save the boundary.
fullish outside off, Gambhir drops it towards point and they hare across for a single.
short ball, comes on slowly and Yusuf cross-bats it wide of mid-on for a single.
back of a length and angling across, Gambhir guides away to third man for a single.

Yusuf's shredding Rahul through the off side today. With or without room. Again, Rahul keeps it just outside off, and Yusuf's upright stance as he gets across to off stump means he still has room to power it away. Top-batting. KKR are taking this away easily here.
he advances again, Rahul lands it full on the middle and leg line. Gambhir whips through wide mid-on.
flat and on a length, Gambhir defends after getting half forward.
full toss again, Yusuf bangs it right back and Rahul can't clutch it. Past the bowler and down the ground for a single.
fullish length outside off, Gambhir trots out and pushes it into the covers for a single.
three successive fours off Rahul Sharma. I must be dreaming. Full toss outside off, Gambhir leans out and strokes it with kindness through the covers.
short ball to finish the over, Yusuf steers straight to point.
another one short of a length, this time Gambhir rides the bounce and steers a single to deep backward point.
short and lively, angling across Yusuf who stays on the back foot and dabs it to third man
width again to Gambhir, who looks to carve over the off side, and Rahul at deep backward point does well to keep it to a single.
on Yusuf's pads, and he whips through square leg for a single.
back of a length from Parnell, outside Gambhir's off stump and guided through point for one.

two lovely strokes from Yusuf give KKR the ascendancy before the third pointless time-out of the day. This time Rahul delivers from closer to the crease, and looks to lull Yusuf into edging to slip. It is Rahul's patent length, short outside off and not giving room, but Yusuf has enough for a nice little cut. This time it is well to the left of point. He had no chance.
ah, just a touch of room outside off as Rahul lands this outside off from wide of the crease, and Yusuf cuts it just past slip.
short and quicker, hurries onto him and Yusuf can't time the pull.
Yusuf reaches out to a full ball outside off and defends. Rare sight.
Gambhir jumps out this time, gets too close to the pitch and digs it out pasr the bowler for one.
tossed up on off and straightening, Gambhir defends down the track.
some more of the deftness from Gambhir, he steers with the softest of hands from just outside off to third man for one more.
over-pitched and too far down the leg side. Gambhir is in too good form to let it go unpunished, and glances it past Rahul's dive at deep fine leg.
Yusuf is away, steering a length ball outside off towards third man.
sback of a length outside off, Yusuf doesn't make contact with it.

Tiwary's innings has been full of adventure. And it has ended in unusual style too. Loopy short ball well outside off, tempts him into the pull but it was really too short and too wide, and he ended up chopping it onto the stumps. Ryder hurries across from point, and has another friendly word with Tiwary.
short of a length outside off, Gambhir cuts it backward of point for a single.
length ball from Kumar on the pads, whipped to Parnell at deep square leg where a mini-fumble allows the batsmen to get two.
again Gambhir looks to advance, this one is fuller and on middle and leg, and he whips through the leg side for a single.

that kind of day for Pune. Yuvraj foxes Gambhir with a classy arm ball as the batsman advanced. He was not to the pitch, and did not read the turn. Ended up getting an outside edge that ran away through the vacant slip region.
Yuvraj lets this slip, slow and loopy, rank full toss outside off. Tiwary thumps it but finds deep cover.
another one on the money, Tiwary plays it right back to the bowler
back of a length, Tiwary covers the line and defends.
tossed up on the stumps and played into the off side
two tight overs and Pune are back in it. Length ball on off stump to end the over, Gambhir guides straight to cover-point.
again Tiwary goes across to off stump. This time he looks to cut and under-edges it to third man.
Tiwary walks across and looks to slap a full and fast ball outside off, through to square leg. Swipes and misses.
another one comes across at 115 kph, this time Tiwary gets bat on it, but finds point with the steer.
big change of pace on that slower one, lands a second time before it gets to the keeper. Tiwary was fooled by it, tried to push at it and missed.
short of a length outside off, Tiwary lets it go through to Robin.
and again, nearly a replay of the previous ball. Parnell appeals for a catch behind this time, Taufel says no. Gambhir against flirted with it as it moved away from short of a length.
Parnell responds with a good ball, but Pune can't afford 2 fours before every good ball. Short ball, lands on the seam and shapes away, even as Gambhir pokes loosely from the crease.
well, he hit a decent ball last time, this one was in the slot as well. Parnell over-pitches, Gambhir leans half forward and caresses it through the covers.

Gambhir plays the shot of the day, looks almost out of place in the IPL. Back of a length ball outside off, no fuss from Gambhir, just stays where he is and meets it on the top of the bounce through the covers. Idyllic.
Tiwary backs away to a back of length ball and cuts through backward point for a single.
angling across outside off, Gambhir steers quietly backward of point for a single.
and again, full and lively on middle and leg. Slog this at your own peril. Tiwary doesn't.
nice little battle this. Tiwary thinks of backing away and opening up the off side, Rahul sees him and lands it on a length on leg stump. Tiwary's forced to defend.
Tiwary sets himself up for a mock charge, Rahul sees him and fires it full and fast at 98 kph. Tiwary defends.
short again, but tight lines just outside off. He goes for a cut, and finds point.
short of a length and angling in, worked away to backward square leg. No run this time.
not much turn as he lands the first one short of a length on the stumps. Gambhir plays it away to the leg side for one.
a violent end to a comic over. Tiwary gets a length ball coming into him, and swings it cleanly over deep midwicket. See you later.

you won't believe this. Ferguson throws again as Gambhir drops to the off side and runs. He hits the stumps and doesn't appeal. Gambhir's made his ground. Ferguson looks sheepish. Yuvraj just looks on hoping it doesn't run to the boundary. Ryder is guffawing away without control. Parnell breaks into a laugh as well. This is hilarious! For the record, no overthrows this time!
a saner sequence of events this time with Tiwary on strike, he just guides to mid-off for one.
short of a length outside off, dropped to the covers for a single.
good ball, Gambhir plays inside the line to a fullish delivery outside off.

action replay! Replace Parnell with Thomas. Replace the missed throw with a direct hit that deflected off the stumps at the bowler's end. Replace Ferguson's small, disappointed face, with a smaller and more glum-looking face at the end of it all. Tiwary has 10 runs off 2 balls after nearly being taken out by a bouncer, and dabbing backward of point. Easy does it.

comedy of errors and a lovely little moment! Parnell gives Tiwary the bouncer, catches him lazy on the front foot and nearly hits the helmet as he swerves away late. The ball dribbles to the off side as Tiwary scoots down the pitch. Ferguson collects and hurls it at the stumps, and misses. Four overthrows. Parnell runs across to Ferg and makes as though he is strangling him. All in jest! And then, pats him on the back for the effort.
ugly but effective. Tiwary backs away, gets a length ball on leg and goes for an agricultural hoick to the leg side. Inside edge, runs away to square leg for four. Parnell just looks bemused.

jaffa. Tiwary's got two of them, and survived both. This one angled across him as Parnell rolled his fingers over it, but it landed on the seam and bounced extra, tennis-ball like. Tiwary did well to drop the wrists.
on the pads again, Gambhir looks to flick and gets something on it, away to square leg for one.
nervy start this for KKR. Gambhir gets one that goes away from back of a length, and looks to waft loosely. Miss.
angles into the pads, Gambhir falls over as he looks to flick, and misses. Taken on the pad.
full and angling into the pads, Tiwary misses the on-drive and is struck on the pads. Stifled appeal - that was going down the leg side.
